name: Code Edit Flow
summary: Read, modify, and commit code files safely with surgical edits.

steps.note: Always read before touching — understand current state
SURGICAL: search_text must appear exactly once. Prefer this over full rewrites.
Only for brand new files. For existing files use edit_file or confirm full overwrite.
Verify the change looks right before committing
Format: 'type: clear message about what changed and why'

notes: Workspace root = aquarium/ parent directory (the squidmind repo root)
Never write outside the repo without explicit user instruction
Prefer surgical edits over full rewrites — fewer tokens, less risk
